events.headline: US-EU tariff truce extended by 60 days (Reuters 2026-05-18)
events.detail: USTR and the Commission extended the standstill on the 20 % reciprocal tariff to July 17; consumer-tech importers had priced a 40 % chance of expiry. Futures on XLK rose 0.6 % after the close; the July 17 deadline is the next decision point.

events.headline: Fed signals one more 25 bps hike at June meeting (Bloomberg 2026-05-19)
events.detail: Two FOMC voters said a June hike is the base case unless May CPI undershoots; fed funds futures moved from 35 % to 60 % probability. Regional banks and utilities lagged the index by 1 %. Decision due at the June 16-17 meeting.

summary: Tariff thaw is mildly bullish for consumer tech; Fed hike risk weighs on rate-sensitive sectors. Net policy_risk_level=medium.
